Hi Asha — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: validate inference latency and cost for your search ranking pipeline on 512-token average queries.
- Success metric: <10ms p50 generation for reranker component at 50 qps and unit cost target of <$0.0008/token.
- Non-functional: SOC2 evidence and retention policy required; data-in-transit encryption and tenant isolation for pilot.

Decision / procurement signals
- You mentioned the economic approver is likely Sara Liao (VP of Data) and procurement gates are handled centrally. We still need a direct procurement contact and a sense of PO timing (30/60/90 days).

Attachments (sent): evaluation deck, preliminary pricing term sheet — see attached.

Proposed next steps
1) Can you confirm the budget owner (Sara?) and introduce procurement contact by reply? (If procurement prefers a short vendor questionnaire, forward it and we’ll prioritize.)
2) I'll schedule a short technical runbook review with Marissa (CS) to scope the pilot footprint (GPU sizing + KV caching strategy) — propose Jun 27, 11:00am PT.
3) We’ll produce a 2-week pilot proposal + a one-page SOW and an estimated cost delta for the pilot by EOD Jun 24.

If anything above is off, flag it and I’ll adjust. Appreciate the intro to procurement when you can.

Thanks,
